title: Stability & Safety Update
headline: Under-the-hood hardening: smarter resource handling, safer registry writes, and several reliability fixes.
changes: Fixed: Slider tweaks (Win32 Priority, Mouse Queue, etc.) could trigger overlapping PowerShell registry writes when applied rapidly — each operation is now properly queued so only one runs at a time.
Fixed: System Cleaner scan and clean operations could run simultaneously if triggered in quick succession — both are now single-flight, preventing resource conflicts.
Fixed: Several components could attempt UI updates after navigating away from them, causing rare state warnings — all affected areas now safely cancel pending work on navigation.
Fixed: RAM usage card on the dashboard could show a stale value after running the Memory Cleaner — it now refreshes correctly after the OS settles.
Fixed: Premium purchase confirmation screen could update after being dismissed if the network response arrived late — the update is now cancelled on exit.
Improved: Boot authentication sequence is more resilient to slow network conditions — the startup flow no longer risks a state race on poor connections.
